prompt:
Public specification:
Build a 32-bit global history shift register, including support for rolling back state in response to a pipeline flush caused by a branch misprediction. When a branch prediction is made (predict_valid = 1), shift in predict_taken from the LSB side to update the branch history for the predicted branch. (predict_history[0] is the direction of the youngest branch.) When a branch misprediction occurs (train_mispredicted = 1), load the branch history register with the history after the completion of the mispredicted branch. This is the history before the mispredicted branch (train_history) concatenated with the actual result of the branch (train_taken). If both a prediction and misprediction occur at the same time, the misprediction takes precedence, because the pipeline flush will also flush out the branch that is currently making a prediction. predict_history is the value of the branch history register. areset is a positive edge triggered asynchronous reset that resets the history counter to zero.



Input widths {'areset': 1, 'predict_valid': 1, 'predict_taken': 1, 'train_mispredicted': 1, 'train_taken': 1, 'train_history': 32}; output widths {'predict_history': 32}. Clock clk; sample after the posedge edge has settled. Each row's values are driven before the sampled edge. Optional mid input changes occur AFTER sampling, before the other edge, and are carried to the start of the next row. Protocol seed 20261121.
Respond to EVERY supplied issue in order with compact JSON {responses:[
{issue_id,decision:"accept"|"rebut",reason,spec_quote,edits:[{path:[strings],value}]}]}.
For rebut, use an exact spec quotation and no edits. Use rebut when the contract already has the
proposed value or its existing example already expresses the rule. Compare against Current contract
before writing an edit. A rebuttal quote must come from Public specification. Port widths and
experiment timing instructions supplied after it are not spec quotes. An accept must change a field. Prefer
a small edit such as
["rules","rule_ID","condition"], ["states","state_name","meaning"], or ["reset","first_released_cycle"].
Whole fields may also be replaced as ["rules","rule_ID"], ["states"], ["reset"], ["mid"], ["uncertain"].
A whole rule may add or delete by id (delete with null). Preserve the current schema, including reset
kind none, sync, async or unspecified, reset name a public input or null, and exact same_cycle /
next_cycle strings. Put initial-value clarification without a physical reset in state meaning or an
explicit uncertain field rather than making up a reset kind. EVERY rule example remains 2–4 cycles.
If changing uncertain, preserve its shape: [{rule_id (existing rule or "global"),note,candidates:
[one or more distinct strings giving plausible interpretations]}].
Include all issue responses in order, including those unchanged from any previous attempt. No port changes.
